pay_detail: 2026 tuition: $3,500 for the 4 week institute, $5,000 for the 6 week institute. $60 application fee.
name: National High School Institute (Cherubs): Policy Debate Institute
what_you_do: Train in policy style debate in a 4 week or 6 week summer institute. The 2026 institute was fully online.
who_can_apply: Students rising into grades 9 to 12 the summer they attend. The page asks for a class rank near the top 30 percent and experience or interest in policy debate.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application opens this winter. Rolling admission through April or until the labs are full. 2026 dates were June 28 to July 25 (4 weeks) and June 28 to August 8 (6 weeks).
how_to_apply: Submit the online application with the $60 fee. Then send extra materials such as a debate record, a letter of recommendation and your transcript. You need a laptop with a webcam, a mic and Microsoft Word.
notes: The 2026 program was online only. Check whether 2027 is online or on campus. Financial aid and scholarship page exists on the NHSI site but was not read.
